description: This file defines classes related to post-mortem data and call stack information within the Thunder PluginHost namespace. It includes JSON serialization for call stack data and post-mortem data structures, with methods for copying, moving, and managing internal data.

classes.name: CallstackData
classes.description: Represents individual call stack frame data including address, function name, module, and line number, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: PostMortemData
classes.description: Encapsulates post-mortem information including worker pool metadata and a collection of call stacks.

classes.name: PostMortemData::Callstack
classes.description: Represents a call stack with an ID and a list of call stack frames.

methods.name: CallstackData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and fields.

methods.name: CallstackData(const Core::callstack_info& source)
methods.description: Constructs CallstackData from a source callstack_info structure, converting address and setting fields.
